usedFor: ClearCRM holds estimates, invoices and payments, and HubSpot keeps the customer's contact current through “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment” in ClearCRM, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A recorded payment changes how you treat a customer, and this writes it to their contact.

watchOut: “Update Contact” works by email, and “New Payment” in ClearCRM is polling, so changes arrive after a scheduled check.
